prompts.prompt:
Create section 7 of 8 of the PNPLINE blue logistics concept. Recent cost image is supporting visual style reference (navy typography, white/ice-blue, large breathing room), not a layout to copy. ONE horizontal 16:10 high-resolution website FAQ section, no header/footer, browser or device. It must look like the same elegant site, not an infographic slide.
Pale ice blue #F3F8FA background. A centered compact eyebrow 常见问题 in #00ABE1 followed by confident navy headline 咨询前，您可能想了解. Below, exactly SIX FAQ question/answer entries in a refined 2-column by 3-row editorial grid, thin subtle rules and delicate small cyan 01–06 numbering, no raised cards or generic colorful icons. All answers expanded and visible in the concept image. Each entry has title bold ink, small minus indicator right to imply an accordion, body muted navy, very readable Chinese. Generous whitespace between entries. Visually balance typography like original minimal channel concept. Body text must remain crisp; enough horizontal space and line height. Do NOT add a large photo because this is the calm reading section before the dark photographic quote ending.
Exact six entries (preserve all wording):
01 需要提供哪些信息才能询价？
请提供所需服务、销售渠道、预计业务量及联系邮箱。若已掌握商品品类、包装尺寸、重量和目的地，也可在补充说明中填写。
02 业务刚起步，货量还不确定，可以咨询吗？
可以在业务量中填写“暂不确定”，并说明正在筹备的销售渠道或发货计划。提交后再进一步确认服务是否适用及所需信息。
03 一件代发和FBA中转补货应该如何选择？
面向消费者逐单发货时，可先查看一件代发服务；需要向Amazon运营中心备货或补货时，可先查看FBA中转补货。两类需求也可以同时说明，具体作业范围需进一步确认。
04 是否可以从中国直接发往美国？
请提供起运城市、商品品类、货量与目的地。是否支持该起运地、采用何种运输方式，以及具体衔接环节，需要根据实际情况确认。
05 报价是否包含税费和全部附加费用？
询价时请核对运输、清关服务、进口税费、仓储、操作和配送等项目的包含与不包含范围。具体以正式报价中列明的项目、条件和有效期为准。
06 我需要IOR服务吗？
请说明商品信息及目前的进口安排，并在补充说明中写明“需要IOR”或“暂不清楚”。所需资料、可提供的服务及责任边界，需要进一步确认。
Bottom modest underlined text link 还有其他问题？提交您的需求 ↗ in exact darker CTA teal-blue #007FA8.
No invented promises or yes-guarantees, no green/sage, no prices, no other FAQ items. Headings Noto Sans SC-like, editorial hierarchy and thin details closely match preceding sections.
